title: validation(text): a non-plain object (Date, Map, class instance) on a text-family field passes the string arm and is stored as sent
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 (read from source). Follow-up S4 of contract review issuecomment-6591249009 on PR #29638 (#29562): the text-family twin of #29562's sibling (3).
reach: the engine write doors (insert, update by id, update by predicate) from flows, hooks and server code. A JSON body over REST carries no `Date`, `Map` or class instance.
业务理由: `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`'s `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES` arm (#29133) refuses a plain object or array with the value-shape sentence, but its object test is `isPlainObjectValue`, which is prototype-strict. So `new Date(0)` on a `text` field passes on its string reading, and the #29241 door leaves it, so the driver stores whatever it makes of a `Date`. #29562 closed the same gap for option fields by refusing any non-plain object `invalid_type`; the text family was out of that card's ruling.
动手的读者: `domain:server` (record validator). Triage grades it; the seat suggests p3.
查重: `text field Date non-plain object stored` → none covering it; nearest #29133, #29241, #29562.

## Wanted

1. Measure first: `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, a class instance and a typed array on `text`, `textarea`, `email`, `url`, `phone` and the rest of `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES`, on SQLite and driver-memory: what is stored and what is answered.
2. Refuse a non-plain object on the text family `invalid_type` with the value-shape sentence, through the same helper #29562 used for option fields (no copy). A string, number or boolean keeps #29241's rule.
3. Pin it per type, plus a control showing a plain string still lands.

**Level:** an engine write accepted today is refused, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (no unique answer moves), the reading #29133 used.
